# Respite: Screen Time Control

> Respite: Screen Time Control is a free screen time app for Android, iPhone and Chrome by Intently. It puts a short pause before the apps and sites you pick, with limits, streaks and a free game layer. Respite Plus adds sync and lets you connect your own AI (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor) over MCP.

Respite runs no AI of its own and does not train models on your data. To our knowledge it is the first mobile screen time app with a built-in MCP server (November 2026); it is not the only screen time product with MCP (LockIn MCP is a desktop website blocker). Prices (at the time of writing, set by the stores, vary by country): free; Respite Plus $4.99 a month, $29.99 a year with a one-week trial, $59.99 lifetime.

## AI and MCP

- [AI and screen time (hub)](https://respite.liveintently.app/ai/): what you can ask your AI, how it works, what is live and what is coming, privacy, setup, comparison with in-app AI coaches
- MCP server address: https://respite-api.liveintently.app/mcp (remote, streamable HTTP, OAuth sign-in with Google or Apple, Respite Plus)
- Read tools (default): get_account (works on the free plan), get_usage, get_insights, list_limits, list_events, get_progress; resources respite://today and respite://week
- Opt-in write tools (the person ticks "Also let it make my limits stricter" on the approval page; unticked by default; connections made earlier stay read-only until reconnected): set_limit (add or lower a per-app daily limit, applies at once; raising one becomes a request), remove_limit (always a request), add_schedule (applies at once), remove_schedule (always a request), list_changes (AI changes and pending requests), undo_change (an AI can undo its own changes)
- Loosening never applies on its own: it becomes a request the person approves in the Respite app's Connected AI screen, which is arriving in app updates; requests expire after 7 days. Every AI change is logged (which AI, what, before and after, the reason given) for 90 days; at most 30 changes per connection per hour
- Not available: an AI changing pause messages or custom rules (planned), writing usage history, earning or spending acorns, blocking apps outside Respite's limits and schedules
